summary_en: 170,000 shares (1.3% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-12 at ¥1,017/share (closing price 2026-08-10), total ¥172.89M. Method: off-exchange block trade. Rationale: mitigate market impact of corporate shareholder sale.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-10, DAIKO XTECH's board resolved to acquire up to 170,000 treasury shares (1.3% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, which totalled 12,669,061 as of 2026-06-30) via off-exchange block trade (ToSTNeT-3). The purchase will be executed on 2026-08-12 at the closing price of ¥1,017/share (including final special quotation), for a maximum aggregate ¥172.89M. The shares will be acquired by matching sell orders placed with the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the designated 08:45 trading window. The company stated that a corporate shareholder has signalled intent to sell a portion of its holdings; the buyback is designed to absorb supply and mitigate short-term market impact. Results will be disclosed after market close on 2026-08-12. The share count is fixed; partial or full execution may occur if market conditions limit available sellers.
